mapper.select: select cr.`id`, cr.`mec_id`, cr.`campus_id`, `class_id`, `student_id`, `class_record_id`, `class_time_num`, `type`, s.student_name from bd_call_record cr left join bd_student s on s.id = cr.student_id where s.is_delete = 0 and cr.is_delete = 0 and cr.class_record_id = #{classRecordId}

select cr.`id`, cr.`mec_id`, cr.`campus_id`, cr.`class_id`, `student_id`, `class_record_id`, `class_time_num`, `type`, stu.student_name, cls.class_name, date_format( clsr.class_start_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%i") class_start_time, date_format( clsr.class_end_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%i") class_end_time, cou.id course_id, cou.course_name from bd_call_record cr left join bd_student stu on stu.id = cr.student_id left join bd_class_record clsr on clsr.id = cr.class_record_id left join bd_class cls on cls.id = cr.class_id left join bd_course cou on cou.id = cls.class_course_id where cr.id = #{callRecordId}
select count(*) from bd_call_record where class_record_id = #{classRecordId} and is_delete = 0 and type = #{type}
select from bd_call_record where id = #{id} for update
